helpful: The sal-v4 segment table with bracketed reached rates gave a clean, leakage-safe anchor for a baseline-band private petition.
The provisioned petition text let me read the claimed split and vehicle section directly rather than inferring from the docket.
gaps: The CourtListener MCP server was rate-limited (HTTP 429, 300/hour) on the very first call in this cell, so the lower-court opinion and the cited circuit cases could not be checked. A per-cell quota or a retry-after-aware sidecar would help.

fedcourts query has no topic or text filter for SCOTUS rows, so there is no way to pull Padilla-type cert priors from the corpus; a QP-topic filter would make the corpus useful as a comparables source.
The petition was truncated at 240 pages, cutting off most of the appended Third Circuit opinion; provisioning the lower-court opinion as its own document would be more useful than the appendix tail.
notes: No brief in opposition exists because the United States waived; documents.json correctly lists none, but a one-line marker that a waiver was filed would save a docket scan.
